text:
A beta particle has less mass than an alpha particle, but the speed of a beta particle emitted
during radioactive decay is approximately 20 times greater than the speed of an alpha particle.
Which statement correctly compares properties of these two particles?
A
Alpha particles are less penetrating because they have less kinetic energy than
beta particles.
B
Alpha particles are more penetrating because they have less kinetic energy than
beta particles.
C
Alpha particles are less ionising because they have more kinetic energy than beta particles.
D
Alpha particles are more ionising because they have more kinetic energy than beta particles.
